name: kasm-use

tools.name: kasm_list
tools.description: List Kasm workspaces you can start, and the sessions you started.

tools.name: kasm_start
tools.description: Start a Kasm workspace session (e.g. 'Chrome', 'Terminal') as the owner, so they can watch it. Returns once the session is running; then call kasm_look. Only sessions you start can be controlled.

tools.name: kasm_look
tools.description: Live screenshot of your Kasm session. Always look before clicking, and look again after each action to confirm it worked.

session_id.description: A session started by kasm_start. Omit to use the most recent one.

tools.name: kasm_click
tools.description: Click at x,y in the coordinate space of the latest kasm_look image.

session_id.description: A session started by kasm_start. Omit to use the most recent one.

tools.name: kasm_drag
tools.description: Drag with the mouse held down from one point to another, in the coordinate space of the latest kasm_look image: move menu items, drag windows or tabs, move sliders, select text, drag and drop.

session_id.description: A session started by kasm_start. Omit to use the most recent one.

tools.name: kasm_type
tools.description: Type text into the focused field of the Kasm session (click the field first). NEVER type passwords, MFA codes, or payment details — stop and ask the owner to take over the session for those.

session_id.description: A session started by kasm_start. Omit to use the most recent one.

tools.name: kasm_key
tools.description: Press keys/shortcuts in the Kasm session, e.g. 'ctrl+l', 'Return', 'Tab', 'Escape'.

session_id.description: A session started by kasm_start. Omit to use the most recent one.

tools.name: kasm_scroll
tools.description: Scroll the Kasm session, optionally at x,y from the latest kasm_look image.

session_id.description: A session started by kasm_start. Omit to use the most recent one.

tools.name: kasm_stop
tools.description: Stop (destroy) a session you started, when the task is finished or the owner asks.

session_id.description: A session started by kasm_start. Omit to use the most recent one.

instructions: Operate Kasm Workspaces desktops. Typical loop: kasm_start (or reuse a running session from kasm_list) -> kasm_look -> act (click/drag/type/key/scroll) -> kasm_look to confirm. Never type passwords, MFA codes or payment details; stop and ask the owner to take over. Stop at CAPTCHAs and hand them to the owner. Call kasm_stop when done.
